title.zh: 蚂蚁百灵发布Ling-3.1-flash：连续写代码17小时，编译器178/182项测试通过
title.en: 蚂蚁百灵发布Ling-3.1-flash：连续写代码17小时，编译器178/182项测试通过

current_state.zh: Ant Group's InclusionAI released Ling-3.1-flash, a ~560B-parameter MoE model with ~25B active parameters and up to 1M context that it says autonomously wrote a Lua-to-x86-64 compiler over 17 hours passing 178 of 182 tests, available in limited free preview via Novita AI and Vercel AI Gateway with open-sourcing planned.
